item_title.value: What is included in each plan?

content.value: What is included in each plan?
Every plan includes the full feature set — the difference is scale, not capability. Higher tiers raise the limits on projects, team members and monthly usage, and add priority support.

editor_settings.title: What is included in each plan?

item_title.value: Can I try it before paying?

content.value: Can I try it before paying?
Yes. The trial runs for 14 days and needs no card, and you keep everything you build during it. If you decide not to continue, the account simply becomes read-only rather than disappearing.

editor_settings.title: Can I try it before paying?

content.value: At any time, in either direction. Upgrades apply immediately and you pay only the prorated difference; downgrades take effect at your next renewal, so nothing stops working mid-cycle.

Cancel within 30 days of your first payment and it is refunded in full. After that, annual plans are refunded pro rata for the unused months and monthly plans simply end with the period you have paid for.

item_title.value: Do you offer discounts for teams or nonprofits?

content.value: Do you offer discounts for teams or nonprofits?
Team pricing starts automatically from the fifth seat. Registered nonprofits and schools get 40% off any plan — send proof of status and it is applied to the account for as long as it stays active.
